description: This file defines the SmartyCompilerException class, which extends the SmartyException class. It provides custom exception handling for compiler errors within the Smarty templating engine, including methods for string representation and properties for error details.

classes.name: SmartyCompilerException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling compiler errors in Smarty templates, extending SmartyException. It includes additional properties to store error details such as line number, source snippet, description, and template identifier.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the exception, including the message property.
